title: CATchy
tagline: Our CATchy improves the UX of diversified blockchains. Today, there are many different chains in existence and they are diversifying. However, it is not easy for users to master multiple chains.  We create wallets that allow bridging on wallets.
description:
CATchy is a wallet that improves the UX of the diversified blockchain.
Blockchains are diversifying. Every blockchain is attractive. It is not uncommon for users to use multiple blockchains. However, in order to master multiple blockchains, a bridge must be used, which is very difficult for users.
So we create a wallet that allows bridging in the wallet UI to improve the UX of diversified blockchains.

To support DApp Developers, CATchy is the 1st sustainable wallet.
 CATchy provide strong incentive for wallet integration. 
We support Sustainable Developer Ecosystem by creating wallet with sophisticated user-interface.
In addition to the basic functions of a wallet, CATchy has an inner-swap function and a bridge function.
To use the inner swap and bridge features, a 0.5% fee of the transaction amount is required.
These fees are distributed according to the staking ratio of the tokens.
Tokens will be distributed once a DApp developer has integrated CATchy and certain conditions (e.g., audited) have been met.
The DApp developer can sell the tokens immediately.
The DApp developer can also earn a sustainable income by staking these tokens. (as long as inner swap fees and bridge fees are charged)
DApp developers can secure sustainable income and sustainable development; DApp developers have an incentive to integrate CATchy; and DApp developers have an incentive to integrate CATchy. Therefore, CATchy is more likely to spread.
CATchy is a wallet that improves the UX of the diversified blockchain.
And to support DApp Developers, CATchy is the 1st sustainable wallet.
how_its_made:
初めに考えたのが、MetaMask snapsを使う方法でした。
しかし、UIを追加することができなかっため断念しました。
インナースワップに0xを使うと思ったのですが、時間が間に合わず完成しませんでした。
一からウォレットを考えることは困難であると考えたため、ブリッジの部分だけを理解してもらえるDemoを作りました。
MetaMaskにブリッジ機能が追加されているようなイメージを持って欲しかったので、MetaMaskの背景をスクリーンショットで撮り、Bridgeボタンを追加しました。
このBridgeボタンにStargateを組み込むことで、イメージのしやすいデモを作成することができました。
https://stargate.finance/widget

ありがとうjunyatakechi
